tools.name: get_free_key
tools.description: Returns the URL where a signed-in MTG Trade account creates an API key with 3 free scan pages per day. Never creates a key itself.

tools.name: purchase_credits
tools.description: Create a 5€ / 500-credit pack (Mollie checkout, or x402 if PAYMENT-SIGNATURE is sent). Poll get_purchase for the API key.

tools.name: get_purchase
tools.description: Poll a credit pack. Returns api_key once when paid.

tools.name: start_scan
tools.description: Upload one binder photo (base64). Requires Authorization: Bearer mgt_…. 3 free pages per day with an account, then €0.01/page. Returns job_id.

tools.name: get_scan_job
tools.description: Poll a scan job until processed or failed. Requires Bearer mgt_….

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_purchase" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_free_key · Private data: get_free_key, purchase_credits · Public sink: start_scan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_free_key · Private data: get_free_key, purchase_credits · Public sink: start_scan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
